CASES.one: From about 20 Google clicks a day to 1,000+ at exam-season peak.
CASES.ch: 10Q Challenge helps students prepare for BITSAT and JEE online. Big coaching brands take up most of Google's first page, so a smaller brand was hard to find.
CASES.ap: We mapped every high-intent search students make, like "bitsat mentorship program 2027" and "bitsat crash course". Then we rebuilt the pages so each one answers one search, kept the old links that were already ranking, and wrote guides and quizzes in an answer-first style that Google's AI Overviews like to quote.
CASES.extra: Google's AI Overview lists 10Q Challenge first for BITSAT mentorship, and names it next to Physics Wallah for JEE mentorship.
shots: Google Search Console, Jan–Jul 2026: 27.3K clicks, 3.51M impressions. Peak in BITSAT / JEE exam season.
"bitsat mentorship program 2027": 10Q listed first in the AI Overview and #1 in the results.
"jee mentorship 2027": 10Q named next to Physics Wallah in Google's AI answer.
134K impressions inside Google's AI features in 3 months.
#3 for a BITSAT logical reasoning quiz (keyword difficulty 72%).
CASES.quote: AegisKoncept rebuilt our site and SEO. We now rank #1 for BITSAT mentorship, and Google’s AI answers recommend us. Daily clicks went from about 20 to over 1,000 in exam season.

CASES.one: 9,873 actions from Google Maps in 6 months: directions, calls and website visits.
CASES.ch: A healthcare clinic wanted more patients from people searching nearby. Its Google profile was there, but it wasn't bringing steady calls and visits.
CASES.ap: We completed and optimised the Google Business Profile, kept it active with posts and photos, built local pages on the website, and helped the clinic collect real reviews. Then we tracked every call, direction request and website click.
CASES.extra: About 1,600 actions every month, steady for 6 months (Feb–Jul 2026). Client name kept private on request.

CASES.one: Every industrial and residential plot sold, with Meta ads and a proper retargeting plan.
CASES.ch: Allied Industrial Park had industrial plots (500 to 1,800 sq. m.) and residential plots to sell in its township on the Bhiwadi–Alwar corridor. Buyers are factory owners, investors and families: a small audience that takes time to decide.
CASES.ap: We built the website around what buyers check first: plot sizes, location on SH-25, security and the investment case. Then we ran Meta ads in stages. First, wide reach to business owners and investors at a low cost. Next, retargeting ads with plot details, prices and site-visit offers to everyone who watched the videos or visited the site. Finally, lead forms and WhatsApp for people ready to visit. Every week we moved budget to the ads bringing real enquiries.
CASES.quote: Their Meta ads and retargeting helped us sell every industrial and residential plot. They reached the right business owners at a very low cost and kept improving the ads every week.

CASES.one: A fresher Shopify store, plus product photos and videos.
CASES.ch: Pot & Bloom sells grow kits, plant care, self-watering pots, gardening tools and corporate gifts across India. The store needed a better homepage and better product visuals.
CASES.ap: We redesigned the Shopify homepage ("Grow something beautiful."), organised the shop into clear collections, made product images and videos, and created promo videos for new launches. We now look after the site every month.
CASES.quote: They redesigned our Shopify homepage, made our product photos and videos, and look after the site every month. Always quick to make changes.

CASES.one: A London website that sorts out business bills and marketing in one place.
CASES.ch: West Coast Services helps UK businesses with energy, gas, water and waste contracts, plus loans, card machines and digital marketing. They needed one website that explains all of it simply.
CASES.ap: We built a clear, friendly website ("We sort out the bills you hate opening") with a page for each service, a savings estimator, a simple switching process and quote forms. Behind it, an admin panel for leads, articles and SEO.
CASES.quote: They built a clean, professional website that explains all our services simply and brings in quote requests from UK businesses.

CASES.one: A business energy comparison site built to rank in the UK.
CASES.ch: ECO Utilities is an independent UK broker. It gets business gas and electricity quotes, explains every charge and handles the paperwork, with no fees.
CASES.ap: We built a clean comparison website ("Compare business energy prices. Pay what you should.") with pages for electricity and gas, room for broadband, water, waste and insurance, and a guides section for UK search.
CASES.quote: Our new website makes comparing business energy easy for customers. Clear, fast and built to be found on Google in the UK.

CASES.one: A booking website for a premium car and bike detailing studio.
CASES.ch: The Drive Clinic does detailing, paint protection film, ceramic coating and washes in Nanak Nagar, Jammu. Bookings and customer details were handled on calls and paper.
CASES.ap: We built a bold website with online booking, a menu of 15 service packages, VIP memberships, a work gallery and a quiz that recommends the right service. Plus a staff and CRM system to manage bookings and customers.
CASES.quote: A bold website with online booking, our packages and memberships, plus a system to manage customers. Exactly what our studio needed.

CASES.ch: Shigeru Beauty sells 24k gold skincare online in the US, a crowded market full of big beauty brands.
CASES.ap: We wrote answer-first guides for the exact questions buyers ask, structured so Google can lift the answer straight into its results. That's called AEO (answer engine optimisation).

CASES.quote: A sharp website that shows our services, prices and work. Easy for people in Derby to find us and walk in.

CASES.one: A worldwide store for handmade cricket bats.
